label: Richmond Campbell, Moral Epistemology…: MORAL_KNOWLEDGE_1 entails justified true moral belief; so…
locator: preamble, 'Third, the entry assumes that moral knowledge entails (roughly) justified true moral belief. interpretation: The entry's own working assumption, not a position it reports for realism: it is recorded as the source of the representational sense of 'moral knowledge' (DEF-MORAL-KNOWLEDGE-REPRESENTATIONAL), which the deviation map shows beside the realist column only as a candidate: that realism answers Q-MORAL-EPISTEMOLOGY this way is not attributed (candidate QUASI-REALISM-MORAL-EPISTEMOLOGY-WITNESS). 'Roughly' is kept: no analysis of knowledge beyond the entailment is recorded.
